ai_positioning.summary: La société TDS n'a pas fait de mentions significatives concernant l'intelligence artificielle, le machine learning ou des technologies similaires dans les extraits fournis du document 10-K/20-F.

risks.title: Critical dependence on T-Mobile for lease revenue post-transaction
risks.score_rationale: Central risk documented in 10-K with strong language regarding T-Mobile dependence. Master License Agreement creates substantial revenue reliance. Loss of lease obligations would have significant impact. New risk category post-August 2025 transaction closure.
risks.summary: Array is now heavily dependent on T-Mobile for tower lease revenue, exposing its business model to any T-Mobile default or strategic change.

risks.title: Potential failure to close Verizon and T-Mobile spectrum sales
risks.score_rationale: Critical risk for liquidity and financial position. Spectrum sales to Verizon and T-Mobile remain subject to regulatory approval and customary closing conditions. Combined potential proceeds exceed $1.2 billion. Failure would adversely affect cash position, debt levels and stock price.
risks.summary: Spectrum license sales to Verizon and T-Mobile remain contingent on regulatory approvals and could fail, jeopardizing planned cash proceeds essential for financial strategy.

risks.title: High costs for decommissioning unused towers
risks.score_rationale: Post-transaction risk with significant cash flow impact. Array faces material costs to decommission towers without T-Mobile tenants and residual lease obligations. New operational challenge arising from wireless operations divestiture.
risks.summary: Array may incur substantial costs to decommission towers vacated by T-Mobile operations, including residual lease obligations affecting cash flows.

risks.title: Difficulty monetizing remaining spectrum assets
risks.score_rationale: Without active wireless operations, Array lacks internal spectrum utilization capability. Remaining unlicensed spectrum faces uncertain buyer demand. High compliance costs to maintain spectrum licenses. Potential regulatory confiscation risk noted in disclosures.
risks.summary: Without wireless operations, Array struggles to exploit or sell remaining spectrum, threatening asset values and exposing company to significant maintenance costs.

risks.title: Delays in fiber deployment and system modernization
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing risk to TDS Telecom competitiveness. Network deployment delays could weaken market position and result in asset write-offs. Supply chain and contractor dependencies amplified post-scale reduction.
risks.summary: Delays or failures in fiber deployment and systems modernization projects could harm competitive positioning and increase operational costs for TDS Telecom.

risks.title: Intensifying competition in wireline and tower sectors
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing competitive pressure from better-capitalized competitors, cable providers, mobile MVNOs and tower companies. TDS faces market share and margin pressure. Severity heightened by reduced scale post-wireless divestiture.
risks.summary: TDS faces increasing competition from larger, better-capitalized competitors threatening market share and margins in wireline and tower services.

risks.title: Lease rate escalation misalignment
risks.score_rationale: Structural risk: if tenant lease rates rise slower than real estate costs, margin compression occurs. Inflation environment prolongs impact duration. Affects tower segment profitability and cash generation.
risks.summary: If ground lease costs rise faster than colocation lease revenue, tower segment profitability and cash flows could face significant margin erosion.

risks.title: Tenant financial default risk and customer concentration
risks.score_rationale: Explicit reference to DISH payment default and concentration dependence on major operators. T-Mobile represents substantial revenue post-transaction. Tenant defaults would adversely affect revenues and cash flows.
risks.summary: TDS faces credit risk from tenant defaults including prior DISH payment issues, with heightened concentration dependence on major operators like T-Mobile.
